grades.overall_note: The agent handled payment correctly (landlord pays direct, nothing through the agency) and sensibly asked for written completion confirmation with a short review date. It did not update the tenants, ignored the pigeon-nest point and the system's provider-assignment mismatch, and got some names wrong in its conflicts section.
